topic: Myth: My teen is too young to earn real money
caption:
A lot of parents assume their teen needs to be older before they can earn anything real.

But 13-year-olds are doing lawn routes, selling digital art, and walking dogs for $200-$400 a month right now.

The only thing they usually need is someone to show them how to start.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
